## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers Department of Education products in the current build:
Higher Education (`HE`) and the Australian Early Development Census (`AEDC`).

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked here. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, or generated smoke data. |
| Unresolved | No source was found in this pass. Do not treat as a factual codebook. |

## Source documents

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| `inst/plida_metadata/*.csv` | DIL product and variable inventory. |
| `R/generate_he.R`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_he.R` | Higher education generated tables, tested value ranges, and calibration checks. |
| `R/generate_aedc.R`, `src/rust/src/aedc.rs`, local smoke parquet read | AEDC generated schema, score ranges, and local category domains. |
| [Department of Education higher education student data](https://www.education.gov.au/higher-education-statistics/student-data) | Official HE source: student/enrolment/completion statistics and variable context. |
| [Department of Education AEDC page](https://www.education.gov.au/early-childhood/about/data-and-reports/australian-early-development-census) | Official AEDC context: triennial census and five developmental domains. |
| [AEDC 2025 data dictionary](https://www.aedc.gov.au/resources/detail/aedc-2025-data-dictionary) | Official AEDC variable/data-dictionary source to use before promoting generated AEDC category labels or cutoffs. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| Higher education | The Department of Education student-data page is an official anchor for student, enrolment, completion, and HELP-style higher-education statistics and variable context. | I did not find exact public code-label tables for every local numeric HE category used in the generated tables. |
| AEDC | Education/AEDC pages and the AEDC data dictionary support the five-domain structure and provide the right official source for AEDC variable definitions. | The generated 0-10 domain-score distributions and `Vulnerable`/`At risk`/`On track` cutoffs remain local generator logic until mapped to AEDC dictionary/scoring rules. |

## Product inventory

| Dataset | Metadata products | Current fplida coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| `HE` | 1 | Five generated tables: enrolment, course, load, completions, HELP. |
| `AEDC` | 30 | Current generator writes one compact core product per requested cycle; default cycles are 2009, 2012, 2015, 2018, 2021. Metadata includes more products/cycles than the current generator writes. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-education.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-education.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and direct PLIDA metadata matches. Treat those sampled
domains/distributions as implementation evidence only, not as official source
data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/education-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/education-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

A stricter source-audited variable-code evidence register is available at
[`education-variable-code-evidence.csv`](education-variable-code-evidence.csv),
with a rendered companion note at
[`education-variable-code-evidence.qmd`](education-variable-code-evidence.qmd).
Use that register to distinguish TCSI/AEDC public source support, local
PLIDA/generator evidence, and fields where exact data-element mapping or
scoring evidence is still missing.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | No direct PLIDA name match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `AEDC` | 23 | 23 | 0 |
| `HE` | 58 | 58 | 0 |

The direct metadata matches mean the generated columns align by name with the
local PLIDA inventory. Code labels and distributions still need the official
Education/AEDC sources before they are used as calibration facts.

## Higher education generated schema and domains

The official HE source describes the administrative collection and key
variables such as course, institution, age, gender, citizenship, Aboriginal and
Torres Strait Islander status, location, basis of admission, attendance type,
attendance mode, country of birth, language, and year of arrival. The tables
below record the current local generator schema.

| Table | Variables | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enrol` | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `YEAR`, `COURSE`, `INSTITUTION`, `ATTENDANCE_MODE`, `ATTENDANCE_TYPE`, `COM_INDICATOR`, `GENDER`, `COUNTRY_BIRTH`, `ABORIG_TORRES`, `DISABILITY`, `HIGHEST_PARTICIPATION`, `YEAR_LEFT_SCHOOL`, `REPORTING_YEAR_PERIOD`, `MAJOR_COURSE` | `YEAR` tested within requested range; `ATTENDANCE_TYPE` in 1,2; `ATTENDANCE_MODE` in 1,2,3; `COM_INDICATOR` in 0,1 and at most one commencement per course. | Local tests |
| `course` | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `YEAR`, `COURSE`, `COURSE_OF_STUDY_CODE`, `COURSE_TYPE`, `FOE`, `FOE_SUPP`, `INSTITUTION`, `SPECIAL_COURSE`, `COURSE_LOAD` | `COURSE_TYPE` tested 1 to 6; `FOE` is a 4-digit ASCED-like code in local `.HE_FOE_CODES`; `FOE_SUPP = FOE + "00"`; bachelor/course type 1 is locally expected to be most common. | Local tests |
| `load` | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `YEAR`, `COURSE`, `INSTITUTION`, `UNIT_STUDY`, `DISCIPLINE_CODE`, `EQUIVALENT_FT_STUDENT_LOAD`, `STUDENT_STATUS`, `UNIT_STATUS`, `MODE_ATTENDANCE`, `HELP_DEBT`, `LOAN_FEE`, `TOTAL_AMOUNT_CHARGED`, `AMOUNT_PAID_UPFRONT`, `CAMPUS_STATE`, `CAMPUS_POSTCODE`, `CITIZEN_RESIDENT`, `UNIT_STUDY_CENSUS`, `SUMMER_SCHOOL_INDICATOR`, `INDUSTRY` | EFTSL positive; `UNIT_STATUS` in 4,7; `HELP_DEBT >= 0`; `TOTAL_AMOUNT_CHARGED > 0`. | Local tests |
| `completions` | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `YEAR`, `COURSE_CODE`, `COURSE_TYPE`, `FOE`, `FOE_SUPP`, `INSTITUTION` | Completion records are a subset of generated courses; local tests expect completion rate between 30% and 95%. | Local tests |
| `help` | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `YEAR`, `INSTITUTION`, `HELP_DEBT`, `STUDENT_STATUS`, `LOAN_FEE` | HELP records are a subset of load records; debt and fee values are synthetic. | Local tests |

Unresolved HE gap: the local numeric category codes need direct mapping to the
official higher-education data element/codebook before labels are published.

## AEDC generated schema and domains

The official AEDC source identifies five domains: physical health and
wellbeing, social competence, emotional maturity, language and cognitive
skills, and communication skills/general knowledge. The local generator writes
compact domain-score records for children aged about 4 to 6 in each cycle.

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_AEUID` | Character ID | DE agency person key. | Local smoke output |
| `GENDER` | Categorical | Local generated domain `Male`, `Female`. | Local Rust/smoke |
| `AGEINMONTHS` | Integer | Local generator targets age 4 to 6 at cycle year, expressed in months. | Local Rust |
| `STATE` | Integer/code | State/territory from spine. | Local generator |
| `ATSI`, `LBOTE`, `SPECIALNEEDS` | Categorical | Local generated domain `Yes`, `No`. | Local Rust/smoke |
| `SCHOOLTYPE` | Categorical | Local domain `Government`, `Catholic`, `Independent` with local weights 0.65/0.20/0.15. | Local Rust |
| `REMOTENESS` | Integer/code | Local domain 1 to 5 with local weights 0.65/0.20/0.10/0.03/0.02. | Local Rust |
| `SEIFADECILE` | Integer | Local generated range 1 to 10. | Local Rust |
| `CYCLE` | Integer | Requested AEDC cycle year. Defaults: 2009, 2012, 2015, 2018, 2021. | Local R wrapper |
| `PHYS`, `SOC`, `EMOT`, `LANGCOG`, `COMGEN` | Numeric | Local score range 0 to 10, rounded to two decimals. | Local Rust |
| `PHYSCATEGORY`, `SOCCATEGORY`, `EMOTCATEGORY`, `LANGCOGCATEGORY`, `COMGENCATEGORY` | Categorical | Local domain `Vulnerable`, `At risk`, `On track`; local cutoffs are `<4.5`, `<6.0`, otherwise on track. | Local Rust |
| `DV1`, `DV2` | Integer flag | `DV1 = 1` if vulnerable on 1+ domains; `DV2 = 1` if vulnerable on 2+ domains. | Local Rust |

Unresolved AEDC gap: the generator comments approximate 10% vulnerable and
15% at risk shares, but this pass did not verify official percentile cutoffs
or cycle-specific cut scores. Do not use those shares as official calibration
targets until sourced.

## Research uses and limits

HE can support tertiary-education spell examples, HELP exposure, course-load
logic, and links to later earnings outcomes. AEDC can support early-childhood
development examples. Both need official code-label crosswalks before
research-facing tables interpret numeric category codes.

## Build implications

1. Add codebook metadata for HE category labels before promoting HE examples.
2. Decide whether AEDC 2024 should be added to the default cycle list; current
   generator defaults stop at 2021 even though recent official reporting
   includes 2024.
3. Keep AEDC domain scores clearly marked as synthetic local scores unless
   cycle-specific AEDC scoring documentation is linked.
